lines: Thus in house in Vatsalikā bestowed standing; having concentrated mind many; previously heard considering by own intellect; śāstras from them obtained essence.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ gṛhe vatsalikāvitīrṇe sthitaḥ samādhāya matiṃ bahūni pūrvaśrutānyākalayan svabuddhyā śāstrāṇi tebhyaḥ samavāpa sāram
